full_details: School broke at eleven. You walked the market with a twin on each hand until they tired of hands. Butter was fourpence. A woman said it had been threepence at Michaelmas. Richard nodded from behind your father's stall and went on selling. Quiney took your hand in both of his, said London agrees with you, and asked nothing. Judith said loving countryman in his voice before he was ten yards off. You told Hamnet not to laugh, and he did. At the bakehouse you offered to make Anne's purchase and knew less than she did. They talked of the loaf's weight and did not make it a lesson. A penny each. Susanna was not there. Her gingerbread went home in a paper, and you gave it to her in the hall.
one_sentence: Quiney took your hand, Judith kept his voice, and Susanna's penny came home in a paper.
title: Walked the market, and Susanna's penny came home in paper
